<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 13"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Celestial Mercy](/Feats.aspx?ID=4562) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Nephilim" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=518" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 81

**Prerequisites**
[Angelkin](/Feats.aspx?ID=4542), [Lawbringer](/Feats.aspx?ID=4545), [Musetouched](/Feats.aspx?ID=4546), or another lineage feat associated with celestials

</column>

---

Your celestial powers allow you to remove lesser [afflictions](/Rules.aspx?ID=361) with ease. You can cast [_cleanse affliction_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1467) twice per day as a 4th-rank divine [innate spell](/Rules.aspx?ID=279).
